title: Litigation Associate
description:
**Company Description**
RPLC – Rane-Pingle Law Chambers is a boutique law firm built on three generations of legal experience and a specialized focus on Technology Law and related domains. Co-founded by tech-focused litigators and policy experts, the firm combines strong courtroom practice with deep knowledge of cyber law and regulatory frameworks. RPLC serves high-growth startups, tech enterprises, and digital-first businesses at the intersection of innovation and compliance. Its work spans cybersecurity incident response, IP and trade secret protection, data privacy and global tech compliance, fintech and SaaS regulation, and litigation for digital offences. Team members collaborate closely with technology-driven clients who expect clear, practical legal guidance tailored to complex digital environments.

**Role Description**
The Litigation Associate will work full time on-site in the Pune Division, handling technology-focused disputes and general commercial litigation matters. Day-to-day responsibilities include drafting pleadings and motions, preparing written arguments, and assisting in strategy for trials and hearings before various courts and tribunals. The role involves conducting detailed legal and factual research, reviewing case documents, and supporting the preparation of evidence and witness materials. The Litigation Associate will coordinate with clients, participate in client meetings, and assist senior counsel with depositions, cross-examinations, and courtroom proceedings. The position also includes monitoring regulatory developments in technology law, contributing to internal knowledge resources, and collaborating with the wider team on complex litigation and crisis management mandates.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong foundational skills in Law, including knowledge of civil and criminal procedure, evidence, and technology-related statutes and regulations.
* Candidates should possess skills in drafting Motions and other litigation documents such as pleadings, written statements, applications, and legal opinions.
* Candidates should possess advanced Research skills, including case law analysis, statutory interpretation, and familiarity with legal databases and technology law resources.
* Candidates should possess skills related to Depositions and witness work, including preparation of examination questions, reviewing testimonies, and assisting in cross-examinations.
* Candidates should possess experience appearing before Courts and tribunals, or strong readiness to develop advocacy skills under supervision.
* LL.B. or equivalent law degree from a recognized institution; enrollment with a Bar Council and eligibility to practice law.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines.
* Interest or prior exposure to technology law, cybersecurity, data privacy, or fintech will be considered an advantage.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and maintain professional ethics and confidentiality.

title: IT & Cyber Technical Risk Metrics Specialist Compliance
description:
Role Overview:

This role governs, monitors, and continuously improves IT & Cyber risk metrics so they are

fit for purpose, aligned with Cyber Strategy, and meet expectations set by the Group CISO.

Operating within Banking, Finance, and Hedge Fund environments, the role ensures metrics

reflect financial risk exposure, operational resilience, and compliance with global regulatory

frameworks. The role leads the annual Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and provides

strategic inputs to the Technology Risk Forum.

Key Responsibilities:

• Metrics Governance & Cyber Strategy Alignment: Define, review, and maintain IT &

Cyber KRIs/KPIs in line with Cyber Strategy and Group CISO directives; map to risk

appetite thresholds and business services.

• Continuous Improvement & Remediation: Monitor failing metrics; lead root cause

analysis and remediation plans. Implement a Metric Rewrite Protocol for metrics that

consistently fail or are misaligned.

• RCSA Execution: Lead annual RCSA across technology domains; ensure residual risk

remains within appetite and align methodology with Group CISO expectations.

• Strategic Reporting & Governance: Provide decision-ready inputs to the Technology

Risk Forum: posture, trends, material events, remediation, and asks.

• Compliance & Regulatory Alignment (Global): Maintain cross-framework control

mapping and evidence across ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF 2.0, COBIT, ISO 31000;

and regulations/obligations including SOX 404, GDPR, DORA (EU), PCI DSS v4.0, and

applicable regional rules (e.g., FFIEC/US, UK PRA/FCA, MAS TRM, HKMA, APRA CPS

234).

• Stakeholder Engagement: Liaise with Application, Infrastructure, Service Owners, SOC,

IT Ops, Risk, Compliance, and external auditors/regulators. Influence remediation and

strategic risk initiatives.

• Automation & Reporting: Partner with BI/GRC teams to deliver automated dashboards

and single source of truth for metric definitions, thresholds, owners, and evidence.

• Execute delegated tasks as deemed appropriate by the Group CISO and other

empowered Group Cyber leadership authorities, ensuring timely and effective

completion in alignment with organizational priorities.

• Support the Group Cyber Strategy end-to-end, driving alignment of all activities,

decisions, and deliverables with strategic objectives and business outcomes.

Candidate Profile:

Experience:

• 3 - 5 years in IT/Cyber Risk, GRC, or Technical Assurance within financial services.

• Hands-on designing/operating KRIs/KPIs and turning failing metrics green.

• Led RCSA and audit/regulator engagements across multiple regions.

Skills:

• Technical: vulnerability and patch governance, IAM/PAM, cloud security, incident

response, DR/BC, change risk.

• Risk & Compliance: appetite, control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST CSF, COBIT, ISO

31000), SOX 404, DORA, GDPR, PCI DSS.

• Tooling: GRC platforms (ServiceNow/Archer), dashboards (Power BI/Tableau), CMDB,

ticketing (ServiceNow/Jira).

• Soft Skills: communication, articulation, presentation, stakeholder influence, executive

narratives.

Preferred Certifications:

• - CISM / CRISC

• - ISO 27001 Lead Auditor

• - ITIL

• - Cloud security certs (AWS/Azure/GCP

title: AVP - Compliance
description:
**About Us**

Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (‘‘Jefferies,’’ ‘‘we,’’ ‘‘us’’ or ‘‘our’’) is a U.S.-headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U.S. broker-dealer, was founded in the U.S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U.K. broker-dealer, was established in the U.K. in 1986. Our strategy focuses on continuing to build out our investment banking effort, enhancing our capital markets businesses and further developing our Leucadia Asset Management alternative asset management platform. We offer deep sector expertise across a full range of products and services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset and wealth management in the Americas, Europe and the Middle East and Asia.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute strategic compliance initiatives aligned with business goals.
* Leadership and Influence: Strong leadership skills to inspire and motivate the compliance team and influence stakeholders.
* Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of regulatory compliance requirements and best practices in the stock broking industry.
* Ethical Conduct: Commitment to upholding ethical standards and fostering a culture of integrity and compliance.
* Adaptability and Resilience: Ability to adapt to changing regulatory environments and navigate complex compliance challenges.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide compliance leadership and guidance to business and support functions, fostering a strong culture of ethical conduct, regulatory compliance, and accountability.
* Oversee accurate and timely regulatory reporting and submissions to SEBI, stock exchanges, depositories, and other applicable regulatory authorities, including daily, weekly, monthly, and event-based requirements.

* Review and draft responses to regulatory observations, inspection findings, and queries, ensuring submissions are accurate, comprehensive, and completed within prescribed timelines.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the stock broking and investment banking businesses, including SEBI and exchange requirements.
* Implement regulatory changes through appropriate enhancements to internal compliance policies, procedures, controls, and monitoring frameworks.
* Oversee compliance with applicable KYC, AML/CFT, sanctions, client onboarding, and related internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support investment banking compliance matters, including transaction-related compliance, conflict-of-interest assessments and clearances, information barriers, wall-crossing, and handling of confidential and unpublished price sensitive information.
* Provide compliance advice and guidance to business and support functions on day-to-day regulatory matters and new business initiatives.
* Develop and deliver compliance training to employees on applicable regulations, internal policies, regulatory developments, and expected standards of conduct.
* Identify emerging compliance and regulatory risks and proactively implement appropriate controls, monitoring, escalation, and remediation measures.
* Maintain appropriate compliance documentation and regulatory records to support governance, audit, inspection, and management oversight requirements.

* Educational Qualifications: Can be either CA or CS or LLB or post graduate in finance.
* Minimum of 5-7 years of progressive experience in compliance within the stock broking industry/merchant banking and market practices.
* Strong knowledge of SEBI regulations and exchange guidelines.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to manage multiple matters simultaneously
* Ability to operate independently while also functioning effectively as part of a collaborative team

title: Senior  Tax & Compliance Analyst - VCS
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
The Senior Analyst, VCS plays a critical role in strengthening the accuracy, scalability, and AI-enabled execution of Avalara’s U.S. Voluntary Compliance Services (VCS) operations across multiple jurisdictions and complex client environments. As client complexity, historical exposure, and voluntary disclosure volumes increase, this role ensures consistent SLA performance, reduces compliance and penalty risk, and embeds AI-driven workflow improvements that enhance productivity and quality. This individual contributor is expected to operate as a Bar Raiser, elevating execution rigor, mentoring junior analysts, and applying AI in measurable ways to improve speed, insight, and operational scale across the VCS lifecycle (from transactional data intake and nexus validation through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting of historical returns prepared for filing).
  
  
**#Hybrid**
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* For Customers Delivers high-accuracy, on-time preparation of historical Sales & Use tax returns for filing — through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting — across multiple jurisdictions, along with voluntary disclosure submissions, proactively mitigating exposure to penalties, interest, and audit risk.
* Acts as a senior point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, providing clear status communication and documentation that help customers understand risk remediation and the outcome of their VCS engagements.
* For the Business Improves operational leverage by: Reducing manual effort in transactional data validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, and notice handling.
* Standardizing VCS status, nexus, and exposure reporting. Accelerating turnaround for large historical scopes and complex multi-state disclosures.
* Supports margin and discount discipline by minimizing re-work, return revisions, and avoidable escalations.

**For The Team Raises Talent Density Through**

* Mentorship and coaching of juniors on VCS standards, nexus and exposure judgment, and client communication. Structured review and quality control discipline for voluntary compliance spreadsheets and historical returns.
* Sharing templates, SOPs, and AI-enabled best practices that uplift the whole team.
* For Our AI-First Strategy Improves turnaround time per voluntary disclosure / historical project.
* Increases accuracy and consistency across returns, disclosure spreadsheets, and periods. Raises analyst productivity and independence by leveraging AI-enabled workflows already defined for the team.

**Responsibilities (Outcome-Based Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end preparation, processing, analysis, and quality assurance of historical Sales & Use tax data and returns for multi-period, multi-jurisdiction VCS engagements — including custom pSTRA, Tax Summary Reports, and voluntary compliance spreadsheets submitted to state taxing authorities — so returns are accurate and ready to be filed, delivering ≥99% accuracy and 98–100% on-time SLA adherence.
* Independently manage complex reconciliations and variance analysis between client transactional data, prior filings, and proposed disclosure returns, including altering or adding transaction data where required while maintaining clear audit trails.
* Serve as the senior primary point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, owning sensitive negotiations and status conversations.
* Maintain a 24-hour turnaround time for critical client escalations and compliance inquiries related to voluntary disclosures, historical returns, notices, or exposure questions.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of complex, historical transaction-level data and U.S. Sales & Use tax law, ensuring data is accurately validated, troubleshot, transformed, and reported — including nexus setup — so historical returns and disclosures are prepared and ready to be filed.
* Improve document and data retrieval turnaround time by 15–25% using AI-supported research, pattern recognition, and tracking tools.
* Standardize weekly VCS status, nexus, risk, and exposure reporting using AI-enabled formatting and summarization tools.
* Identify and implement at least one scalable AI-enabled workflow enhancement within the first 6 months, with clear measurement of productivity or quality impact.
* Manage relationships with customers, project managers, state taxing authorities, and internal/external Avalara partners throughout the VCS lifecycle to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, risks, and outcomes, including proactive de-escalation through direct customer calls when needed.
* Mentor I1/I2 analysts in independent case handling, nexus and exposure analysis, high-quality documentation, client-ready narratives, and effective, compliant AI usage.
* Maintain and continuously improve SOP documentation for VCS (data intake, nexus validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, disclosure submission, return preparation for filing, notice handling, and closeout) aligned to client contracts, jurisdictional rules, and Avalara standards.
* Provide proactive support to CAMs and Sales to help drive successful voluntary compliance and remediation sales cycles, including answering scoping questions, joining key client calls, and providing clear, data-backed delivery perspectives.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**

* The Senior Analyst, VCS must demonstrate exceptional applied AI capability that produces measurable operational impact, not just experimentation.
* This includes: Embedding AI tools into transactional data cleansing and enrichment, reconciliation and variance explanation, nexus and historical exposure summaries, pSTRA preparation, and VCS escalation workflows.
* Quantifying impact (e.g., time saved per engagement, reduction in manual review hours, improved turnaround time per disclosure period, fewer rework cycles).
* Applying AI responsibly while exercising professional judgment, especially for compliance-sensitive topics such as taxability, nexus determinations, exposure estimates, and final return values. Sharing AI best practices (prompts, workflows, validation steps) to elevate team capability and embed them into SOPs.
* Continuously identifying automation opportunities aligned to efficiency, risk reduction, scalability, and consistent client experience.
* Casual or convenience-based AI usage does not meet Avalara’s AI Bar Raiser standard.

**12-Month Success Signals**

* Within 12 months, the Senior Analyst, VCS will demonstrate: Sustained ≥99% preparation accuracy across their VCS portfolio (returns prepared for filing, disclosure spreadsheets, amendments, and corrections).
* 98–100% on-time performance for agreed VCS SLAs, including during peak workload and complex multi-state disclosures.
* 15–25% reduction in document and data retrieval turnaround time through AI-enabled research, tracking, and templated requests.
* Measurable reduction in re-work and re-opened engagements via robust validation controls, better upstream scoping, and AI-supported checks.
* At least one implemented AI-driven workflow enhancement (e.g., automated variance narratives, pSTRA/template builders, data-mapping accelerators) delivering quantifiable productivity gains.
* Documented AI and process best practices adopted across the VCS team and incorporated into SOPs.
* Strong independent handling of complex escalations, including high-exposure periods, nuanced jurisdictional and nexus rules, and sensitive client and state-authority scenarios, with minimal senior intervention, including proactive de-escalation through direct client calls and clear, solution-focused communication.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, or related field; or MBA in Finance.
* 3–4+ years of U.S. indirect tax / Sales & Use tax compliance experience, ideally including voluntary disclosure, amnesty, or remediation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-jurisdiction return portfolios and handling compliance escalations (e.g., notices, penalty and interest issues, nexus questions).
* Advanced MS Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA, large data-set handling) and demonstrated ability to work with complex historical transaction data to prepare accurate disclosures and historical returns ready for filing.
* Proven experience using AI tools to improve operational speed, quality, or scale (for example, in data analysis, documentation, or reporting workflows).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex historical tax, nexus, and exposure topics in clear, client-friendly language to customers, project managers, and state taxing authorities.
* AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

title: RC-REGULATORY COMPLIANCE-CSV - Veeva Validation-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY – GDS Consulting – Enterprise Risk (ER) – Regulatory Compliance – CSV - Veeva - Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
As part of our EY – ER - Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Senior actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you will consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager (Validation/Tester – Veeva) to lead validation, testing activities and compliance across various Veeva modules, regulated and business critical computerized systems for global pharmaceutical clients. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and drive strategic initiatives for business process transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead CSA/CSV strategy in collaboration with Governance and risk-based validation approach for the Veeva Vault platform, balancing modern CSA principles (critical thinking, risk-based test coverage) with CSV rigor where required for specific vaults/regulatory contexts.
* Perform risk assessments on platform changes (configuration, integration, releases) to determine appropriate validation rigor and evidence requirements per change.
* Define validation/testing evidence requirements in partnership with the QA Engineer role — ensuring test coverage decisions are risk-justified and audit-defensible.
* Review and approve validation deliverables (validation plans, risk assessments, test evidence, validation summary reports) before closure.
* Ensure platform changes comply with applicable regulations (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5) and internal Computerized System Validation policies.
* Provide compliance guidance to internal Leads and vendor team members on how CSA principles apply to specific configuration/integration scenarios.
* Support internal/external audits and health authority inspections — act as the platform's validation SME during inspection readiness and response.
* Partner with QA/Change Management to ensure Change Control records carry appropriate validation justification and evidence.
* Stay current on evolving CSA guidance (e.g., FDA's CSA draft guidance) and industry practice, advising the CoE on policy updates.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years in CSV within the pharmaceutical, life sciences or consulting organizations.
* Comfortable working with distributed teams across India, Prague, and US time zones.
* Strong influencing skills to drive practice change (CSV → CSA) across a delivery team that includes multiple other vendor roles.

**Must-Have Skills & Attributes**

* Experience in Computer System Validation, with demonstrated leadership transitioning teams from traditional CSV to CSA practices.
* Deep knowledge of GAMP 5 (2nd edition), FDA CSA guidance, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11.
* Experience defining risk-based testing/validation strategies that reduce documentation/testing burden without compromising compliance.
* Experience validating cloud/SaaS platforms (Veeva Vault experience strongly preferred) in a GxP environment.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections/audits as a validation SME.
* Strong stakeholder influencing skills — this role must drive adoption of CSA thinking across delivery teams (Configuration, Integration, QA) who may default to legacy CSV habits.
* Experience partnering with QA/Test Automation teams to align risk assessments with automated test coverage decisions.
* Strong project management, problem solving and communication skills
* Apply structured and analytical thinking to improve delivery efficiency and client outcomes.

**Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes**

* Prior experience specifically validating Veeva Vault implementations (any vault — Clinical, RIM, QMS, Safety, Medical, CRM).
* Experience building or updating an organization's CSA policy/SOP framework.
* Experience with Veeva Vault QMS/QualityDocs as the vehicle for validation documentation.
* ISPE GAMP 5 training/certification
* High attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* Familiarity with emerging regulatory trends, such as CSA or digital validation approaches.
* Adaptability to changing regulatory and business environments.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE), Certified Software Quality Assurance (CSQA)
* Information Security or Risk Management certifications.
* Any Veeva Quality certification.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Head of Legal Counsel
description:
**Who We Are**

Fulcrum Digital is a global AI-first enterprise transformation company with over 25 years of experience. We partner with enterprises across financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, higher education, and logistics to move from AI experimentation to scalable business outcomes. Fulcrum Digital works with over 100 global clients, including Fortune 500 enterprises, combining deep industry expertise with capabilities in enterprise AI, digital engineering, cloud modernisation, platform integration, and generative AI.

**The Role**

The Head of Legal Counsel will provide strategic leadership and oversight to Fulcrum Digital's legal function, ensuring alignment with corporate goals, regulatory compliance, and risk management. This role requires an experienced professional to draft, review, and negotiate contracts, safeguard intellectual property, manage corporate governance, and oversee all legal aspects of the business while fostering a high-performing legal team.

**What You'll Do**

* **Contract Management**
* Draft, review, and negotiate a diverse portfolio of contracts to secure win-win outcomes for Fulcrum Digital and counterparties.
* Act as a business enabler by proactively recommending solutions and driving the contracting process.
* Stay current on industry trends and technological advancements to incorporate necessary protections into contracts.
* Serve as the custodian of all contracts and oversee the finalization of EULAs for SaaS offerings.

* **Renewals & Extensions**
* Monitor and ensure timely renewals and extensions to prevent gaps in contracting.
* Collaborate with business teams to expedite the contracting process and mitigate the risk of operating without contracts.

* **Reporting & MIS**
* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports on services being provided without contracts.
* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports on contracts scheduled for renewal within the next 90 days.

* **Intellectual Property**
* Drive and oversee the registration and protection of company trademarks to safeguard intellectual property.

* **Insurance Management**
* Ensure all insurance coverage gaps are identified and resolved within established timelines.
* Manage relationships with brokers to actively oversee and optimize the organization's insurance policies.

* **Corporate Governance & Secretarial Functions**
* Provide robust support for corporate governance and secretarial activities.
* Ensure timely filing and compliance with corporate regulations across all jurisdictions.
* Engage reputed vendors to assist in filings, registrations, and other compliance requirements.
* Offer legal counsel during ISO 27001, ISO 27701, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance audits.

* **Team Leadership & Development**
* Build and lead a high-performing legal team by setting clear goals, providing mentorship, and conducting performance evaluations.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB); a Master's degree in Law (LLM) is preferred.
* Minimum of 12–15 years of legal experience, preferably in the Information Technology space, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* In-depth knowledge of corporate law, compliance, intellectual property, and insurance.
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and decision-making abilities.

**Nice to Have**

* Strategic mindset with the ability to act as a business enabler.
* Demonstrated expertise in risk management and regulatory compliance.
* Strong leadership and team-building capabilities.

description:

* Review proposals and provide recommendations for terms that provide additional protections for data access, storage, and transfer
* Deployment of Confidential Information Management Plans (CIMPs) across accounts and engagements to all industries, Operating Portfolios, Products, and Acquisitions
* Prepare MSA summary, CIMP recommendations, and CI/CIMP training documentation
* Support the development and update of General Guidance, Market Offering Playbooks, and Account/Engagement CIMPs, as required

The C&P team is responsible for the mitigation of incidents and the investigation of Insider Risk Program (IRP) cases where professionals have been identified for exfiltrating Deloitte and client sensitive confidential information.
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Pune/ Chennai
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM

* General understanding of contracts and ability to provide interpretation of contract terms

* Proven track record influencing diverse stakeholders and driving common outcomes with a strong understanding of commercial contracting processes, including terms and conditions

* Strong verbal and written English communication skills

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
ABOUT ICE CREAM: Life Tastes Better with Ice Cream Once separated from Unilever, the The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) will become the world’s largest global Ice Cream Company, with over 100 years’ experience delivering a diverse range of indulgent, yet responsible, craft food experiences. We have 35 brands, including 3 one billion Euro brands (Magnum, Wall’s, Ben & Jerry’s), a strong presence in over 60 countries, generating annual revenue of €8 billion. All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win. We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. We are committed to developing and nurturing talent. You will have ample options for career growth and exploration. Your career development will be a priority for us, and we are dedicated to supporting your growth journey within the new company. ABOUT GBS: Global Business Solutions:   Global Business Solutions (GBS) is TMICC’s trusted transformation partner, delivering innovative and integrated solutions from design to delivery. We develop future-fit capability, expertise and technologically advanced solutions to unlock speed, simplicity and operational agility across TMICCs operations. This is your chance for a ‘once in a lifetime’ career experience, playing a part in the creation of a fully independent, new Ice Cream company and a greenfield GBS organization supporting Europe Supply Chain Finance Processes. Employees within GBS partner with multiple teams in countries across Europe ranging from Factories, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Services, Procurement. You will become part of the delivery service engine behind TMICC’s hero brands and will have the opportunity to implement new solutions and processes alongside an innovative tech stack that is been delivered as part of the separation from Unilever program. What you'll be responsible for 1. Litigation Portfolio Management
  
  

* Maintain and update the global litigation tracker (case status, financial exposure, key milestones)
* Monitor critical deadlines (filings, hearings, escalation points) and ensure timely follow-up
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across jurisdictions
* Consolidate litigation updates from regional legal teams 2. External Counsel Coordination
* Act as the central coordination point for administrative interactions with law firms
* Track case progress and ensure timely collection of updates
* Support engagement processes (e.g., engagement letters, onboarding documentation)
* Ensure adherence to billing guidelines and internal compliance policies 3. Financial & Risk Tracking
* Track litigation exposure (best, expected, and worst-case scenarios)
* Support provisioning and accrual processes in coordination with Finance
* Monitor external legal spend by matter and region
* Identify trends, variances, and cost drivers across the portfolio 4. Reporting & Insights
* Prepare monthly and quarterly litigation reports for senior stakeholders
* Develop and maintain dashboards covering: o Case volume by region and category o Financial exposure o External legal spend o Case outcomes (win/loss/settlement)
* Generate structured insights to support risk visibility and decision-making 5. Process & Tool Management
* Support implementation and maintenance of litigation and matter management tools
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Identify process improvement and automation opportunities
* Ensure adherence to Legal Ops governance and standards 6. Cross-functional Collaboration
* Partner with Regional Legal, Finance, Procurement, and Compliance teams
* Ensure timely communication and alignment across stakeholders We're looking for someone who
* Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB) or related field
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in:
* Litigation support, legal operations, or legal services
* Shared Services / GBS environment (preferred)
* Exposure to multi-jurisdictional litigation
* Experience with legal technology platforms (matter management, e-billing tools)
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills
* Experience with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI is a plus)
* Basic understanding of legal billing and provisioning processes
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
* Structured, process-oriented mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Comfortable working in a global, matrix environment What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
* Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
* Flexible ways of working
* Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
* Time off to rest and recharge
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Specific benefits vary by location

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: People Relations Partner
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the team
  
  
The People Relations team enables fair, consistent and legally compliant people practices while supporting business transformation. The team partners with P&C, Legal, Compliance, business leaders, employee representatives, unions and external advisers to manage complex employee and labour relations matters across the organisation.
  
  
Based in Pune within Castrol P&C team, this role reports to the Head of People Relations and acts as the organisation's employee and industrial relations expert for India. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on oversight of complex cases, negotiations and workforce change.
  
  
Key tasks
  
  

* Develop the employee and labour relations strategy for India, establish governance frameworks and drive consistent, high-quality practices.
* Support and guide business partnering teams with complex and sensitive employee relations cases, including misconduct, ethics concerns, conflicts of interest, retaliation allegations, harassment complaints, grievances, disciplinary actions, executive investigations and whistleblowing matters by guiding partnering teams.
* Oversee investigation quality, evidence reviews, outcome consistency, escalation processes and litigation risk; ensure lessons learned are embedded into business practices.
* Lead negotiations with recognised trade unions and employee representatives, including wage negotiations and long-term settlements.
* Develop bargaining strategies, negotiation plans and communication approaches, and negotiate collective agreements covering pay, benefits, working time, attendance, shifts, organisational change, flexibility and employee welfare.
* Provide employee and labour relations leadership during acquisitions, divestments, integrations, outsourcing, reorganisations, site closures and workforce reductions.
* Assess labour risks, consultation obligations and employee communication requirements, partnering with Legal and P&C to develop compliant implementation plans.
* Lead engagement with labour authorities and support conciliation matters, standing orders interpretation, labour code compliance and industrial dispute prevention.
* Conduct regional workforce risk reviews, establish People Relations metrics and provide leaders with clear insight on workforce risks and trends.
* Coach P&C and business leaders, support business partnering professionals, build capability and establish standards that strengthen decision-making and employee experience.
* Build constructive relationships with executive leaders, unions, representative bodies, compliance teams and external advisers while supporting business transformation objectives.

**Experience Required**

* Degree in business, law, human resources management or a related discipline.
* Significant experience (8-12 years) in employee relations and industrial relations in India, ideally supporting manufacturing or operational workforces.
* Demonstrated experience working with recognised trade unions and leading collective bargaining, wage negotiations or long-term settlements.
* Strong practical knowledge of Indian labour and employment requirements, including labour authority engagement, conciliation, standing orders and industrial dispute prevention.
* Proven experience leading and guiding complex workplace investigations and managing sensitive complaints, disciplinary matters and employment risk.
* Experience supporting organisational change, restructuring, integrations, outsourcing, site change or workforce reduction programmes.
* Strong judgement and the ability to balance legal, employee, operational and reputational considerations in complex decisions.
* Excellent influencing, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence advising senior leaders and working across a matrix organisation.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive briefings, negotiation materials and sensitive employee communications.
* Ability to use case data, risk indicators and People Relations metrics to identify trends, strengthen governance and improve manager capability.
* Reduced employee and labour relations risk exposure and litigation cost.
* Effective and timely resolution of complex employee disputes and investigations.
* Successful negotiation outcomes and constructive employee representative relationships.
* Compliant, well-managed workforce transitions and organisational change.
* Improved manager and P&C capability, decision quality and consistency of practice.

Privacy
  
  
The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*
*If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.*

title: Legal Entity Booking-AVP
description:
Join us as a "Legal Entity Booking-AVP" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful as a "Legal Entity Booking-AVP", you should have experience with:
  
  
**Person Specification**

* Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
* Excellent relationship building, networking, negotiation and influencing skills.
* Excellent time management, prioritization and multi tasking skills.
* Excellent execution skills.
* Strong data analytical and quantitative skills.
* Strong project and change management skills.

**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant/ Certified Internal Auditor/ CPA or equivalent qualification in Auditing or Risk Management/Graduate or Post Graduate with experience in Controls i.e. Controls Business Partner or Control Assurance and Tester and Operational Risk Management.
* Extensive experience in Internal Audit, Control Business Partnership, Controls Assurance & Testing and Operational Risk Management.
* Comprehensive understanding of governance and control frameworks and processes, and all aspects of operational risk management. Highly motivated, business-focused and forward-thinking.
* Extensive experience in senior stakeholder management, ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly in a business context. Ability to manage reporting lines and relationships across multiple disciplines.
* Controls Experience in areas viz. Markets, Markets Operations, KYC, Financial Crime, AML, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions, Trade Operations, Credit Lending, Global Payments, Reference Data etc.
* Markets Product Knowledge.
* Understanding and application of Data science and analytics.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Sound commercial judgment and overall understanding of the Financial Services Industry, particularly the business impact of the regulatory environment.
* Experience of designing, communicating & implementing internal control policies.
* Proficient in use of MS Office packages (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
* Knowledge of internal control and regulatory requirements & practice e.g. Turnbull, Sarbanes-Oxley, COSO, Basel II Accord relating to operational risk preferred.

Location-Pune.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To assess the integrity and effectiveness of the banks internal control framework to support the mitigation of risk and protection of the banks operational, financial, and reputational risk.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Knowledge of business areas, products, processes and platforms to be able to assess risk
* Collaboration with various stakeholders across the bank and business units to improve overall control effectiveness through detailed documentation of control assessments, procedures, and findings.
* Identification and investigation of potential weaknesses and issues within internal controls to promote continuous improvement and risk mitigation aligned to the bank’s control framework, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations.
* Development of reports to communicate key findings from risk assessment including control weaknesses and recommendations to control owners, senior management, and other stakeholders.
* Execution of reviews to determine the effectiveness of the bank's internal controls framework aligned to established and evolving policies, regulation, and best practice.
* Implementation of adherence to the Barclays Controls Framework and set appropriate methodology of assessing controls against the Controls Framework.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Research Policy Advisor
description:
The role requires a senior academic/research professional with a strong understanding of how a university is established, governed and developed, including its statutory bodies, academic structures, research framework, regulatory approvals, policies and institutional processes.

* Advise University leadership on academic, research and institutional policy matters.
* Support the development of a strong and sustainable research ecosystem and governance framework.
* Provide strategic inputs on University establishment, governance, academic structures and statutory processes.
* Interpret UGC, AICTE, Ministry of Education, ANRF, DST and other regulatory frameworks.
* Draft and review University policies, ordinances, regulations, guidelines and SOPs.
* Advise on the constitution, roles and functioning of statutory, academic and research bodies.
* Develop frameworks for research, innovation, consultancy, sponsored research and collaborations.
* Support policies relating to IPR, technology transfer, research ethics and academic integrity.
* Identify opportunities for funded research, research centres and national/international collaborations.
* Strengthen industry–academia partnerships and interdisciplinary research initiatives.
* Monitor changes in higher education and research regulations and advise on institutional implications.
* Benchmark established universities and research institutions for policy and system development.
* Support regulatory approvals, inspections, accreditation, rankings and institutional assessments.
* Develop institutional frameworks for improving research quality, output and visibility.
* Provide inputs for enhancing research funding, publications, patents and technology transfer.
* Coordinate with academic schools, departments, research centres and administrative teams.
* Prepare policy papers, proposals, briefing notes, analytical reports and recommendations for leadership.
* **Qualification:**
  Ph.D. in a relevant discipline from a recognised University/Institution is mandatory.
* **Experience:**
  Minimum 10 years in higher education, university administration, research management or related fields.
* **Competencies:**
  Strong knowledge of Indian higher education, regulatory frameworks, governance, policy drafting and strategic institutional planning.

title: Trade Compliance Screening Professional
description:

SMRT's offering covers drilling, mechanical cutting, loading and hauling, demolition and recycling, and various solutions to increase automation. **Trade Compliance Screening Professional**
,

* Identify local issues and escalate if needed:

So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are interested in the position, please submit your resume and cover letter no later than 30th October 2026.

title: Compliance Analyst, Expert Network
description:
**About AlphaSense**
The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
  
  
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
The Compliance Analyst, Expert Network plays an important role in supporting the day-to-day compliance needs of AlphaSense's Expert Network business. Reporting to the Head of Expert Network, this role supports expert sourcing and onboarding, client compliance onboarding and inquiries, and other compliance questions that arise across the Expert Network business.
  
  
As part of the Compliance team, the Compliance Analyst will help review experts being considered for client projects, apply AlphaSense's sourcing and compliance policies, and provide guidance to the teams responsible for sourcing experts. The role will also support client-specific compliance requirements and help respond to questions and concerns from clients about AlphaSense's Expert Network compliance practices.
  
  
This role is well suited for someone who is interested in developing experience in compliance within a fast-paced technology company. * Support ongoing client compliance needs by responding to questions and concerns, assisting with due diligence requests and compliance questionnaires, and providing information regarding AlphaSense's Expert Network compliance policies and processes.
* Address compliance matters that arise in the day-to-day operation of the Expert Network business, applying established policies and procedures and coordinating with Legal and other internal stakeholders when additional review is required.
* Maintain accurate records of compliance reviews, decisions, and client requirements, and contribute to the development and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures, internal guidance, and training materials.

**Who You Are**

* 2-4 years of experience in compliance, legal, operations, customer support, financial services, or another role involving research, analysis, or process-based work is helpful. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Interested in developing knowledge of compliance concepts relevant to expert networks, including confidentiality, material non-public information (MNPI), and insider trading considerations. Prior experience with these topics is helpful but not required; role-specific training will be provided.
* Highly detail-oriented, with the ability to review information carefully, identify relevant details, and consistently apply established policies and procedures.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in working through different scenarios and using established guidance to determine the appropriate next steps.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with both internal teams and clients.
* Organized and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize work, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.

* Comfortable learning and working with new systems, tools, and technology used to support compliance processes.

title: Manager - Financial Compliance
description:
**Company Description**
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.
  
  
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role purpose**
The Financial Compliance Manager is responsible for providing proactive financial compliance partnership to the Accounts to Reporting function. The role identifies and assesses financial risks, supports the design and operation of effective internal controls, and helps ensure that control deficiencies are remediated accurately and on time. The role also enables compliance by design in change initiatives, supports risk-based governance, and uses data-driven insight to strengthen the control environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* 1. Internal Control Framework and Financial Risk Management
* Identify, assess and strengthen financial risks and controls, with particular focus on the Internal Control Framework (ICF).
* Ensure the accurate and timely closure of remediation actions arising from identified control deficiencies.
* Assess emerging risks identified by the business or countries—including geopolitical, environmental and technology-related risks—and support the development of appropriate mitigating actions.
* Support the function-level Risk Assessment Framework and ensure key financial compliance risks are appropriately considered.
* Strategic Business Partnership and Compliance by Design
* Collaborate with Business Partners, tower heads, global leaders and other functional stakeholders on ICF, external audit observations and other material compliance matters.
* Facilitate the exchange of new ideas, leading practices and relevant benchmarks to improve the control environment.
* Promote “Compliance by Design” for new systems, process changes and automation initiatives.
* Assess risks arising from significant process or system changes through the SPD process and evaluate whether proposed controls adequately mitigate those risks before implementation.
* Continuous Monitoring and Insight
* Use data-driven continuous risk monitoring, including the Risk Dashboard where feasible, to identify emerging, suspicious or non-compliant trends.
* Translate monitoring insights into clear, practical actions and constructively challenge and influence stakeholders to address identified risks.
* Global Governance and Standardisation
* Identify country-level variations in processes and controls.
* Drive global control benchmarking and standardisation across countries where practical, while respecting local requirements.
* Ensure that local variations continue to mitigate the relevant risk and meet the intended control objective.
* Compliance Awareness
* Support the development and delivery of ICF training and compliance-awareness activities for relevant stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
* Advanced knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Deep understanding of financial compliance, internal controls and control documentation requirements, including how controls are implemented and sustained.
* Working experience in financial data analytics.
* Sound knowledge of internal controls, business-process best practices in an agrochemicals or manufacturing environment, and audit techniques.
* Working knowledge of, and partial training in, PCAOB, COSO and SOX requirements.
* Approximately 6–8 years’ audit experience in a decentralised SAP/ERP environment.
* Experience coordinating or supporting internal control testing programmes and managing relationships with external auditors.
* Experience working in a large multinational organisation.
* Demonstrated exposure to senior stakeholders through written communication, face-to-face discussions and formal presentations.
* Understanding of practical country-level issues and trade-offs, combined with the ability to articulate the need for adherence to global standards and principles.

title: Records Management
description:
Join Barclays as a Records Management role, where to enable effective data governance, risk management, and compliance within the bank, acting as a liaison between business units and the Records Management (RM) function, translating business needs into actionable strategies and ensuring efficient implementation of RM. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.
  
  
**To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:**

* Data & Record Governance Framework : Strong command of records and information governance frameworks, including ISO 15489 and ARMA's Generally Accepted Record Keeping Principles (GARP), with experience designing and operating an Information Governance Reference Model.
* Regulatory Knowledge spanning UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act, FCA/PRA record-keeping Requirements(Including SYSC), MIFID II Retention Rules, AML and BASEL- related retention obligations and/or SOX.
* Proficiency in building and maintaining enterprise retention schedules.
* Working knowledge of Enterprise Records Management platforms such as OpenText, Iron Mountain and SharePoint/Microsoft 365 records management, at a leadership or hands-on level.
* Experience designing and executing eDiscovery and litigation hold process.
* Demonstrated capability leading paper-to-digital migration, cloud records repository implementation, and automated disposition or legal hold workflow design.
* Sound understanding of risk and controls methodology, including Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) practices, audit remediation, and first/second-line-of-defense operating models.
* Familiarity with how records management intersects with data management and data privacy.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in records management, information governance, or a related risk/compliance discipline, including a minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* A demonstrated track record of building and running an enterprise-wide records management function within a regulated financial institution - bank, insurer, or comparable organization.
* Experience leading large, geographically distributed or matrixed teams, including onshore/offshore delivery models typical of banking operations.
* Direct Experience managing regulatory examinations and audits related to records management with a credible history of remediation delivery.
* Accountability for budget ownership and vendor management, including physical storage contacts and ECM licensing arrangements.
* A strong background in change management, experience engaging and infulencing senior stakeholders, up to and including Executive Committee and Board Risk Committee Level.
* A Strategic Mindset, with experience owning and delivering a multi-year target operating roadmap for a governance or compliance function.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop, implement, and maintain effective governance frameworks for all data and records across the bank's global operations.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and maintenance of a comprehensive data and records governance framework aligned with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
* Monitoring data quality and records metrics and compliance with standards across the organization.
* Identification and addressing of data and records management risks and gaps.
* Development and implementation of a records management programme that ensures the proper identification, classification, storage, retention, retrieval and disposal of records.
* Development and implementation of a data governance strategy that aligns with the bank's overall data management strategy and business objectives.
* Provision of Group wide guidance and training on Data and Records Management standard requirements.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: AVP Risk & Assurance
company: Intellectual Capital HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Associate Vice President – Assurance

**Location:**
Pune

**Function:**
Assurance & Risk

**Experience:**
12+ years post-qualification

**Qualification:**
Chartered Accountant (CA)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Associate Vice President – Assurance**
to strengthen the effectiveness of Internal Audit and Assurance functions across business entities. The role will focus on enhancing internal controls, governance, risk management and regulatory compliance while providing independent advisory inputs to senior management.

The position will work closely with Internal Audit leadership and senior stakeholders to assess audit effectiveness, identify emerging risks, strengthen audit methodologies and drive implementation of best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Audit & Assurance

* Provide independent advisory and assessment support on Internal Audit and Assurance matters.
* Review Internal Audit reports at various stages and discuss significant findings with relevant stakeholders.
* Follow up on resolution of critical audit observations and assess whether appropriate root-cause remediation has been undertaken.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and maturity of Internal Audit functions and recommend improvements.
* Review Internal Audit scope and coverage to ensure adequate focus on high-risk, material and emerging risk areas.
* Assess audit methodologies, audit frequency and overall effectiveness of audit execution.
* Review audit reports to ensure they clearly articulate issues, root causes, potential impact, risks and actionable recommendations.
* Ensure Internal Audits are conducted in accordance with applicable standards, recognized audit methodologies and sound professional judgment.
* Provide guidance on thematic and horizontal audits covering key focus areas and emerging risks.
* Support continuous enhancement of Internal Audit methodologies, frameworks, tools and templates.

Risk, Governance & Compliance

* Advise on appropriate implementation of Accounting Standards and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
* Support strengthening of internal controls, governance and compliance frameworks.
* Stay updated on regulatory developments, industry trends and significant risks relevant from an audit and assurance perspective.
* Identify areas requiring greater management attention across business entities.
* Promote a strong governance, risk and control culture through audit insights, thematic observations and knowledge sharing.

Strategic Projects & Advisory

* Support senior Assurance & Risk leadership on strategic projects, including:
* Valuation-related assignments
* Business restructuring strategies
* Evaluation of business proposals
* Policy reviews and inputs
* Other risk and assurance-related initiatives
* Lead initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
* Develop a strong understanding of business challenges, opportunities and emerging threats.
* Provide independent advisory inputs to improve the quality, consistency and effectiveness of assurance practices.
* Prepare clear, concise and impactful reports and presentations for senior management and governance forums.

Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with Internal Audit Heads and senior stakeholders across business entities.
* Coordinate with multiple functions depending on emerging risk themes and horizontal audit requirements.
* Manage ambiguity and independently determine appropriate approaches for audit and assurance assignments.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across functions and businesses.
* Engage with professionals from Assurance, Internal Audit, Risk, Accounting and related disciplines.

Key Decision-Making Responsibilities

* Identify appropriate methodologies and approaches for executing assurance assignments.
* Determine areas requiring greater focus across business entities.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve ambiguity during assignments.
* Escalate significant findings, risks, challenges and delays to senior leadership along with recommendations.

Key Challenges

* Working across multiple business entities, functions and stakeholder groups.
* Operating within a fast-paced environment requiring a short learning curve.
* Managing a diverse and evolving scope of assignments.
* Seamlessly transitioning between strategic, assurance, risk and advisory projects.
* Managing multiple priorities while maintaining quality and professional judgment.

Qualifications & Experience

* **Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.**
* **12+ years of post-qualification experience.**
* Strong experience in
  **Internal Audit, Risk, Assurance or related functions**
  .
* Experience within the
  **BFSI / Financial Services sector**
  is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of Internal Audit, Risk Management and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Certification in Internal Audit would be an added advantage.

Functional & Behavioural Competencies

* Strong knowledge of Internal Audit and Assurance frameworks.
* Understanding of risk management and regulatory requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills.
* Strong people management and project management capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments.
* Strong communication, report writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
* Strong professional judgment and ability to challenge constructively.

Role Scope

* **Location:**
  Pune
* **Financial Responsibility:**
  No direct financial targets.
* **Nature of Role:**
  Strategic Assurance, Internal Audit, Risk, Governance & Advisory.
